Two art/observation pack-sets, covering potential participation by 80 people at 40 people per set
Quiet-room sensory support kit for up to 20 people at a time

deliverable.calculation: 220000 + 55000 + (2 * 48000) + 24000 + 18000 + 72000 = 485000 base cents; ceil(485000 * 10%) = 48500 contingency cents; total 533500 cents, below the 600000-cent ceiling by 66500 cents.

in_kind_coverage.assumption: The fictional plan assumes donated coverage: one lead facilitator for 3 hours, two science speakers for 1.5 hours each, two arrival/wayfinding stewards for 3 hours each, and one quiet-room host for 2 hours (14 volunteer-hours total). The v2 creative replan is expected to fit duties within this existing coverage; it does not represent actual people, availability or a commitment.

assumptions: All budget amounts are fictional source-card base prices in integer AUD cents and include modeled taxes and fees; no additional cash prices are estimated.

Version 2 selects SRC-VEN-01 only. Banksia Hall and Paperbark Quiet Room provide 80-seat access and the event window including setup and pack-down; the courtyard add-on is unavailable and is removed from this estimate.
The art activity is reassigned indoors; two 40-person sets cover potential participation by all 80 adults. Hall capacity is 80, and concurrent quiet-room use remains limited to 20.
The venue card includes access to 80 movable chairs (SRC-RES-01); inventory is assumed available at no extra cash charge and should be confirmed in the human floor-plan review.
One quiet kit covers up to 20 people at a time. The creative replan is expected to fit staffing into the fictional donated 14 volunteer-hours; actual staffing remains unconfirmed.
The 10% contingency is applied to total base cost and rounded up to the nearest cent; these source amounts yield an exact 48500 cents.
